name: Patient Recovery Time
query:
SELECT
    p.name AS "Patient ID:Link/Patient:120",
    CASE
        WHEN p.p_age > 0 THEN CONCAT(p.p_age, ' ', IFNULL(NULLIF(p.age_type, ''), 'Year'))
        WHEN p.dob IS NULL THEN CONCAT(p.p_age, ' ', IFNULL(NULLIF(p.age_type, ''), 'Year'))
        WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.dob, CURDATE()) > 0 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.dob, CURDATE()), ' Year')
        WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, p.dob, CURDATE()) > 0 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, p.dob, CURDATE()), ' Month')
        ELSE CONCAT(GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), p.dob), 0), ' Day')
    END AS "Age:Data:100",
    p.sex AS "Sex:Data:100",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(ip.diagnose, ''), diagnosis.diagnosis) AS "Diagnose:Data:160",
    vitals.bp AS "Blood Pressure:Data:140",
    vitals.spo2 AS "SPO2:Data:90",
    vitals.temperature AS "Body Temperature:Data:130",

    CASE
        WHEN IFNULL(ip.type, '') LIKE '%%ICU%%' THEN 'YES'
        ELSE 'NO'
    END AS "ICU Admission:Data:120",

    CASE
        WHEN ip.admitted_datetime IS NOT NULL
            AND ip.discharge_datetime IS NOT NULL
        THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ip.admitted_datetime, ip.discharge_datetime)
    END AS "Recovery Time:Int:130"

FROM (
    SELECT
        patient,
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            GROUP_CONCAT(
                name
                ORDER BY COALESCE(admitted_datetime, scheduled_date) DESC, creation DESC, name DESC
                SEPARATOR '\n'
            ),
            '\n',
            1
        ) AS inpatient_record
    FROM `tabInpatient Record`
    WHERE docstatus < 2
    GROUP BY patient
) latest_ip

INNER JOIN `tabInpatient Record` ip ON ip.name = latest_ip.inpatient_record
INNER JOIN `tabPatient` p ON p.name = ip.patient

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        patient,
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            GROUP_CONCAT(bp ORDER BY signs_date DESC, signs_time DESC, creation DESC, name DESC SEPARATOR '\n'),
            '\n',
            1
        ) AS bp,
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            GROUP_CONCAT(spo ORDER BY signs_date DESC, signs_time DESC, creation DESC, name DESC SEPARATOR '\n'),
            '\n',
            1
        ) AS spo2,
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            GROUP_CONCAT(temperature ORDER BY signs_date DESC, signs_time DESC, creation DESC, name DESC SEPARATOR '\n'),
            '\n',
            1
        ) AS temperature
    FROM `tabVital Signs`
    WHERE docstatus < 2
    GROUP BY patient
) vitals ON vitals.patient = p.name


LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        parent,
        GROUP_CONCAT(diagnosis ORDER BY idx SEPARATOR ', ') AS diagnosis
    FROM `tabPatient Encounter Diagnosis`
    WHERE parenttype = 'Inpatient Record'
    GROUP BY parent
) diagnosis ON diagnosis.parent = ip.name

ORDER BY COALESCE(ip.admitted_datetime, ip.scheduled_date) DESC, p.name;
